name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), created the quickstart script exactly as documented, and received a chat completion response "Hola" from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, which returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro`, which is available and returned a valid chat completion. This is the only deviation from the documented instructions.
